verdict.rationale: Every Supabase project is a full managed Postgres database with auto-generated REST/GraphQL APIs and generated types. The API-key model explicitly separates client use (publishable key, scoped by RLS) from server use (secret key). Per-language SDK references (JS, Dart, Swift, Kotlin, Python, C#) and community reports of building many app backends on it corroborate client and server data access, though one user hit PostgREST limits and fell back to a separate API server. Missing for 10: explicit SDK read/write code examples in the evidence, and first-party documentation of the managed-project provisioning flow beyond the create_project and Management API references.
